Workflow

Directory, RBPN and consent

A members-only directory where display, contact and export are three separate consents. No minor appears in any payload, and nothing about the living shows signed out.

Built in the Hub
Built Directory, consents, the broker, RBPN listings and the job board are built (slice 10). Bulk export refuses for everyone.
Branches
Leadership All branches
Shared services
Directory and communications, Membership and standing
Governed by
D6 · D17 · D28 · R7 · R27

Steps

  1. Set per-field visibility; the ceiling is members, never publicMember
  2. Search with transliteration folding and aliasesMember
  3. Contact through the broker; the address itself never shipsMember
  4. Publish an RBPN profession listing; request a promoted business listingMember
  5. Verify membership and ownership before a listing existsRBPN desk
  6. Drop a lapsed member after the grace windowPlatform

Hands off to

  • directory → comms: contact runs through the broker, never an exported address
  • directory → magazine: a lapsed listing drops out of the magazine's professional directory
